canonical_relation.policy: Canonical Core, Stress, and Holdout cases are neither copied nor used as tuning data.

input_mapping.fixture_conditions: evaluation-only precondition metadata; not a Product field

gold_mapping.expected_typed_semantic_outcome.goal_sem: semantic requirements over RequestIntentV2.goal and completion_conditions; not literal equality
gold_mapping.expected_typed_semantic_outcome.resource: unordered exact resource_type set mapped to RequestIntentV2.resource_responsibilities.source_reads; required_information_semantics uses semantic containment
unordered exact (resource_type, effect) set mapped to RequestIntentV2.resource_responsibilities.outputs
gold_mapping.expected_typed_semantic_outcome.constrai: required semantic subset of RequestIntentV2.constraints; value_semantics is semantic containment unless an enum or opaque identity requires exact value
gold_mapping.forbidden_semantic_outcome: any listed effect, resource, responsibility, ambiguity value, or semantic failure is a failure; list order and natural-language rationale are ignored

gold_policy.must_match: Typed effects, resources, source/output roles, analysis requirement, and ambiguity ownership consequences.
gold_policy.must_not_exist: Forbidden effects, resources, source/output roles, invented targets, or unrequested responsibilities.
gold_policy.allowed_variation: Meaning-preserving goal, completion, reason, and required-information wording plus field/list ordering.

fixture_policy.selected_resource_refs: Minimal synthetic SelectedResourceRef values are embedded only in RESOURCE_SELECTED cases.

freeze_policy.same_round: After review and freeze, baseline and candidates use the same 24 cases without Gold edits.
forbidden_changes: delete failures to improve pass rate
change difficulty or expectations after candidate results
freeze_policy.next_version_condition: Create v2 only for a newly discovered, generalizable failure class absent from v1; re-evaluate baseline and candidate on the same v2 when comparing performance.
